वल्गुसोम an author. Quoted in C. on Gobhilagṛhya-
sūtra Bibl.

वल्लब्रह्मसूत्रभाष्य Oppert II, 5784. This is a Śaśaviṣāṇa
which, if anything, means the Brahmasūtrāṇubhāṣya
by Vallabha.

वल्लभ See Daivajñavallabha, Bhūpālavallabha, Vidvajjana-
vallabha, Vaidyavallabha.
वल्लभ brother of Rūpa and Sanātana.

वल्लभ a grammarian. Quoted in Gaṇaratnamahodadhi
p. 29, by Mallinātha and Rāyamukuṭa.

वल्लभाचार्य also वल्लभ or वल्लभ दीक्षित with the epithet
Viśvānara or Agni, was a son of Lakṣmaṇa Bhaṭṭa,
elder brother of Rāmacandra, and father of Gopī-
[]
nātha and Viṭṭhala. He was the guru of Puru-
ṣottama (Avatāravādāvalī etc.). He was born in
1478 and died in 1530:

वल्लभ son of Śiṅghaṇa Bhaṭṭa, father of Trimalla (Yoga-
taraṅgiṇī), Rāma and Gopa.

वल्लभेन्द्र सरस्वती or simply वल्लभ pupil of Vāsudevendra
Sarasvatī:
 Mokṣalakṣmīvilāsa.

वल्लभ गणक son of Śaṅkara:
 Gaṇitalatā.

वल्लभ न्यायाचार्य
 Nyāyalīlāvatī. Quoted by Gaṅgeśa in Tattvacintā-
maṇi 2, 284.

वल्लभ न्यायाचार्य son of Puruṣottama:
 Nyāyalīlāvatī.

वल्लभगणि pupil of Jñānavimala:
 Sāroddhāra to Hemacandra's Abhidhānacintāmaṇi.
 C. to Hemacandra's Śeṣasaṃgraha.

वल्लभजी गोस्वामिन् father of Gopālajī, who was guru
of Ichārāma (Brahmasūtrāṇubhāṣyapradīpa). Hall p. 93.

Nāgarakhaṇḍasya Sāraślokāḥ and Adhyāyānukra-
maṇī.
 Mahābhāratādhyāyānukramaṇī and Mahābhārato-
ddhṛtasāraślokāḥ.
 Vṛttamālā.
वल्लभदेव poet. Śp. p. 83. Skm. Sbhv.

वल्लभदेव of the 16th century, has laid the Śārṅgadhara-
paddhati under contribution in compiling the:
 Subhāṣitāvali.

वल्लभदेव son of Ānandadeva, father of Candrāditya, grand-
father of Kayyaṭa (who wrote a C. on Ānanda-
vardhana's Devīśataka in 977). Kāvyamālā 1, 101.
He is quoted by Mallinātha

^b:
 Kumārasambhavaṭīkā, including the eighth book.
 Meghadūtaṭīkā.
 Raghuvaṃśapañjikā.
 Vakroktipañcāśikāṭīkā.
 Śiśupālavadhaṭīkā.
 Sūryaśatakaṭīkā.

वल्लभनृसिंह father of the author of Anumānasya Pṛtha-
kprāmāṇyakhaṇḍana. Burnell 121^a.

वल्लभसिद्धान्तटीका सिद्धान्तवाङ्माला bhakti, by Puru-
ṣottama.

 Prātaḥstava.
 Maṅgalastotra.
 Vallabhāṣṭakavivaraṇa.
 Vṛndāṣṭaka.
 Ślokapañcaka.
 Siddhāntavivṛtivivṛti.

.
 CC. Vallabhāṣṭakavivṛtiprakāśa by Puruṣottama,
son of Pītāmbara.

वल्लभाष्टक by Viṭṭhaleśvara, son of Vallabhācārya. AK
278.

Kautukacintāmaṇi.
 Śivapūjāsaṃgraha or Dvaitanirṇayaśivapūjāsaṃ-
graha.
 Sanatkumārasaṃhitāṭīkā.

वल्लभेन्द्र son of Amareśvara Bhaṭṭa, a Telugu Brahman:
Vaidyacintāmaṇi.
वल्लयुपद्धति (?). Quoted in Keśava's Jātakapaddhati. Bhr. p. 30.

Rāmāyaṇa. Verses from it Śp. p. 84. Sbhv.
 Gaṅgāṣṭaka, not in Rāmāyaṇa.

वाल्मीकि कवि son of Rudramaṇi Tripāṭhin:
 Ramalenduprakāśa.

वाल्मीकि कवि another name of Rudramaṇi Tripāṭhin,
the author of the Ramalenduprakāśa.

वाल्मीकिसूत्र alaṃk. Oppert 3209.
 --on Prākṛt grammar. Rice 26.

वल्लभ भट्ट
 Vaidyavallabhā, a C. on the Vaidyavallabha or
Triśatī of Śārṅgadhara.

वल्लभेन्द्र सरस्वती or simply वल्लभ pupil of Vāsudevendra
Sarasvatī:
 Mokṣalakṣmīvilāsa.

वाल्कराम son of Rāmasahāya, composed in 1839:
 Janmeṣṭaśodhana.
वल्लीपरिणय nāṭaka by Vīrarāghava, son of Īśvara.
